criteria.description: A real response-derived artifact exists under the isolated fixture and is bound to the exact design-director receipt and package identity.
criteria.limitations: The artifact is a fictional project-local HTML/CSS/SVG pilot output, not a production site.

criteria.description: The fixed finite graph, budgets, immutable handoffs, blind critique and one-shot repair lineage are enforced and evidenced.
criteria.limitations: The pilot supports only the declared graph and fixed limits; arbitrary orchestration is excluded.

criteria.description: Native desktop/mobile browser evidence and a distinct final structural verification pass the declared artifact, semantic, browser and confinement checks.
criteria.limitations: Complete interaction and intermediate-breakpoint evidence remains outside the final two-render contract.

criteria.description: Fresh independent engineering and visual reviews approve the exact final packet with no Critical or High findings.
criteria.limitations: Reviewers retained Medium/Low/Polish findings for responsive closure, interaction coverage, mobile footer treatment and utility typography.

criteria.description: Phase 2–4 regressions, project tests, coverage, Ruff, mypy and bounded security checks are green within the declared environment.
criteria.limitations: pip-audit is unavailable; host-load causality, production behavior and AAA verification are excluded.

conditions: Keep the exact manifest-bound packet frozen.
Reopen Phase 5 and obtain a new manifest and independent reviews for any source, test, fixture, evidence or scope change.

authority.decision: The exact local packet is accepted as PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS at support A after independent engineering and visual review; no production or AAA claim is authorized.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate on any manifest-bound change or expansion beyond the bounded project-local pilot.

next_action: Keep PHASE5-001 frozen; any future change requires a new exact packet and review cycle.
revalidation_triggers: Changing Phase 5 source, tests, fixture, evidence, reports, policy or architecture inputs
Changing capability identity, authorization, graph, budgets, repair, browser or evidence boundaries
Adding a second eligible capability, host-loaded causal signal, provider, tool, MCP, shell, network, credential, deployment or production path
Seeking AAA, unconditional PASS or production-readiness status
